OK:

  • Is it possible to make rw?? work in conv mode?

At least for now, rw?? (like rw) does not work for terms that depend on bound variables. One of the usual work-arounds for the shortcoming of rw in this respect is to use conv to navigate inside the term and then do rw. It would be very nice to be able to use rw?? in this situation as well to discover possible rws.
#39433 replaces rw??, and (I'm not sure but) based on code comments it seems to support rewriting under binders using simp_rw
